## Reading contract

1. Locate identifiers here.
2. Open only the atomic records named.
3. Re-verify any claim about the present against the repository that owns
   it. A record states when it was last observed, not that it is still true.
4. Open `history/`, `archive/`, and long-form analysis only when asked for
   past reasoning.
